plugins.name: claude-code-feedback
plugins.description: File well-formed bug reports, feature requests, model-behavior reports, and documentation issues against anthropics/claude-code. Fetches the live issue templates, gathers required fields (version, OS, reproduction), and submits via gh CLI.

skills.name: feedback-bug
skills.description: File a well-formed bug report against anthropics/claude-code. Use when the user wants to "report a bug", "file a bug", "open an issue", or describes unexpected/broken behavior in Claude Code they want Anthropic to fix. Interviews the user against Anthropic's live bug_report.yml issue form, renders the body exactly as the form expects, and submits via `gh issue create`.
headings: Filing a bug report against anthropics/claude-code
skills.description_zh: 依据Anthropic实时bug_report.yml访谈并整理规范的Claude Code缺陷报告，按表单格式通过gh issue create提交至anthropics/claude-code。

skills.name: feedback-docs
skills.description: File a documentation issue against anthropics/claude-code — missing docs, outdated docs, incorrect docs, or docs improvements. Use when the user says "the docs are wrong", "can't find docs for X", "the docs contradict the behavior", or similar.
headings: Filing a documentation issue against anthropics/claude-code
2. Parse, 3. Gather, 4. Build body, 5. Title, 6. Preview, 7. Submit
skills.description_zh: 向anthropics/claude-code提交文档问题，涵盖缺失、过期、错误、与行为矛盾或改进建议。

skills.name: feedback-feature-request
skills.description: File a well-formed feature request against anthropics/claude-code. Use when the user wants to "request a feature", "suggest an enhancement", "propose an improvement", or describes something they wish Claude Code could do that it currently can't. Interviews the user against Anthropic's live feature_request.yml issue form and submits via `gh issue create`.
headings: Filing a feature request against anthropics/claude-code
skills.description_zh: 依据实时feature_request.yml收集信息并通过gh issue create向anthropics/claude-code提交功能增强请求。

skills.name: feedback-model-behavior
skills.description: File a report about Claude's model behavior (bad responses, refusals, hallucinations, policy misfires, poor code quality) against anthropics/claude-code. Use when the user is unhappy with *what Claude said or did* — as opposed to a CLI/tool bug. Distinct from the bug skill, which covers CLI/harness issues.
headings: Filing a model-behavior report against anthropics/claude-code
skills.description_zh: 向anthropics/claude-code报告模型回答或行为问题，如错误拒绝、幻觉、策略误触或代码质量，区别于CLI和工具框架缺陷。

skills.name: feedback-refresh-templates
skills.description: Refresh cached Anthropic claude-code issue-form templates and detect drift or new template types. Use when the user says "refresh templates", "update feedback templates", "check for template changes", or when a previous feedback-skill run reported drift. Also discovers newly-added issue-template types in the upstream repo.
skills.description_zh: 刷新缓存的Anthropic Claude Code Issue表单，检查变化并发现上游新模板类型，适用于更新请求或此前发现模板漂移。
